meta_description: Pick a time for a 20-minute call: we look at your AI-built app together and I tell you honestly whether and how we can put it online.
meta_description_demo: A working booking app demo, put online by Deplai. Try it freely: nothing booked here is real. To talk to us, email {email}.
demo_text: This is a demo: everything works like the real thing, but no real meeting is booked and the data is deleted every night.
demo_built_with: See how to get your own app online
hero_lead: 20 minutes on a video call or the phone. We look at your app together and I tell you honestly whether and how we can put it online, and what it would cost.
hero_lead_demo: This is what a small booking app looks like once Deplai puts it online and keeps it running. Try it freely: nothing booked here is real.
contact_p: Email us and we'll agree on a time by email.
no_slots: No free times right now. Email {email} instead.
slots_error: Could not load the times. Please refresh the page.
form_notes_hint: For example a link to your app, or what you're most unsure about.
form_notes_placeholder: E.g.: I built a booking app with Claude but can't get it online…
form_privacy: We use your details only to arrange this meeting.
demo_form_note: Demo: a made-up name and email are fine. We won't contact anyone from them, and they are deleted overnight.
error_slot_taken: Someone booked that time just before you. Please pick another one.
error_slot_invalid: That time is no longer available. Please pick another one.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
error_server_error: Something went wrong. Try again or email {email}.
success_lead: I'll email you a confirmation and the call link. If the time stops working for you, just reply to that email.
success_demo_note: No real meeting takes place and no confirmation email is sent. The booking is deleted overnight. If you want to talk for real, email us.
admin_key_missing: Add ?key=… to the URL to see bookings.
foot_tag: The person who keeps your AI-built app running.
